div.span: 1. install은 root HTML과 참조 Next static assets·manifest/icon을 캐시한다

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;
div.span: 2. activate는 이전 walksafe cache를 삭제하고 clients claim·version broadcast한다

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;
display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;
div.span: 4. API-like path GET은 network no-store, mutation은 worker가 queue하지 않는다

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;
div.span: 5. navigation/root는 network 실패 때 shell cache만 사용한다

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;
div.span: 6. wake lock은 active·visible일 때 요청하고 해제/실패 상태를 표시한다
